editorial: We visited in August, smack in the middle of the wet season (June to September). The splendour of Angkor Wat was slightly dulled by intermittent cloud cover, but we got to be up close and take great photos (that we even used in our wedding invite). And in the afternoon, we pretty much had the world heritage site to ourselves.

Now if your goal is a picture perfect Instagram post, then the dry season (November to February) has the best views. But beware that the mild climate draws massive crowds. According to the tour guides, there are TWENTY times more people in the wet season, so you’ll be jostling for the best spots.
The rest of the year is best avoided due to the extreme heat.
